fragments.contract: Create or reuse the demo OpenStack project/user/flavor/network/security group/keypair/image and boot bkc-openstack-smoke-01 ACTIVE on lab-internal.
fragments.why_it_matters: The proof of OpenStack is not merely Horizon loading; it must create a real tenant resource and show a running instance.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not call 30 complete when only preflight/planned steps ran or when the smoke server has not reached ACTIVE.

fragments.contract: Use the old Proxmox source host 192.168.1.9 and source VMID 132 as the known-good Trixie source. Source auth is BKC SSH key based unless proxmox_source_password is explicitly set. Stream an uncompressed VMA restore into target VM201 on 10.20.0.41, clone VM202, attach vmbr0 networking, and start both guests.
fragments.why_it_matters: The simple source-to-target migration is the reusable Proxmox model: API/SSH pull a VM from the old hypervisor and push it into the new one.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not couple the migration source password to the global BKC Proxmox integration; the old source should use BKC key auth and the global integration should point to the current target after validation.

fragments.contract: The lab HTTP edge on 8081 serves Proxmox UI normally except for a patched proxmoxlib.js that sets PVEAuthCookie secure only when the browser URL is HTTPS. With that cookie present, /api2/json/cluster/resources returns real VM inventory.
fragments.why_it_matters: Proxmox 9's UI forces a secure auth cookie. Through a plain HTTP lab edge, the browser minted a ticket but did not send it back, producing 401 No ticket and an empty Datacenter.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not debug Proxmox API credentials or VM inventory for this symptom until checking browser cookie behavior through the edge.

fragments.contract: 30's final validation must point BKC's Proxmox integration at the newly built target 10.20.0.41, pull the Proxmox snapshot, save it, and sync the inventory into BKC rules.
fragments.why_it_matters: After migration, the old .9 host remains a source, but BKC's operator UI and graph should describe the new Server2 Proxmox role.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not leave BKC inventory pointed at .9 after a successful 20/30 rehearsal.
